title: Layers drawer
description: Map and terrain source management for the Studio scene.

ui.overview: The Layers drawer manages the data sources that define the visible map and terrain. It is where you review what the scene is drawing and how the background data is sourced.

screenshot.alt: Screenshot-style illustration of the Layers drawer in Studio.
screenshot.description: The screenshot shows the Layers drawer open with the layer list, terrain source, and disclaimer button in view.

annotations.label: Disclaimer button
annotations.description: Opens source notes before you use a protected layer.

annotations.label: Source list
annotations.description: Shows the available base layers and terrain sources.

annotations.label: Visibility switch
annotations.description: Turns the selected source on or off in the scene.

controls.label: Layer disclaimer
controls.description: Opens the layer information modal so the user can read source-specific warnings.

controls.label: Layers and terrains list
controls.description: Shows the available base layers and terrain sources with their access and visibility state.

controls.label: Source visibility
controls.description: Turns a layer or terrain source on or off in the current scene.

controls.label: Base maps / Overlays / Terrains
controls.description: Filters the list between base maps, overlay layers, and terrain sources.

controls.label: Sort providers / Sort alphabetically
controls.description: Changes the source order by provider or alphabetically.

controls.label: Color adjustments
controls.description: Shows or hides color adjustments when the selected source supports them.

controls.label: Filters
controls.description: Shows or hides the source-list filters. The button indicates when a filter is active.

controls.label: Update Token / Remove Token
controls.description: Opens provider-token entry or removes a saved token. Removal requires confirmation.

controls.label: Paste Token/API key
controls.description: Enters a provider key or token in the authentication modal. The modal also links to provider documentation and the provider website.

controls.label: Cancel / Validate
controls.description: Closes the authentication modal without saving or validates the entered token.

steps.title: Choose a source family
steps.description: Open Base maps, Overlays, or Terrains, then select a source from the list.

steps.title: Filter and sort
steps.description: Use Filters to narrow the list and the sort controls to find a provider quickly.

steps.title: Authenticate a source
steps.description: Select Update Token, follow the modal links if needed, enter the key, and select Validate.

steps.title: Check the display
steps.description: Turn visibility on and use color adjustments when available. Read the Disclaimer before using a protected source.

notes: Use this drawer when the user needs to change the map foundation or review data access notes.
The layer information modal and layer token modal belong to this drawer-driven workflow.
